# Invoke-AvmLint

## Synopsis

Lint all source files in the resolved module under $Path.

## Description

Routes to the engine matching the module's ecosystem:

  - bicep      -> Invoke-AvmBicepLint     ('bicep lint <file>' per file)
  - terraform  -> Invoke-AvmTerraformLint (AVM tflint rulesets, per scope)

The ecosystem is determined by Get-AvmModuleContext, which honours
the .avm/context.psd1 override file and the -Ecosystem filter.

Returns an envelope with structured Issue records; callers should
treat Status='fail' as a failed lint pass.

Routed by the dispatcher: 'avm lint'.

## Syntax

```powershell
Invoke-AvmLint [[-Path] <string>] [-Ecosystem <string>] [-AllowPathFallback] [-ThrottleLimit <int>] [-SkipModuleVersionCheck] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## Parameters

### -AllowPathFallback

When set, accept a PATH-resolved tool binary that self-reports the
lock-pinned version.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `Switch` |
| Required | false |
| Position | named |
| Default value | False |
| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

### -Ecosystem

Force the ecosystem selector. Defaults to 'auto'.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `String` |
| Required | false |
| Position | named |
| Default value | auto |
| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

### -Path

Working directory whose enclosing module to lint. Defaults to the
current location.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `String` |
| Required | false |
| Position | 1 |
| Default value | $PWD.Path |
| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

### -SkipModuleVersionCheck

Skip the PowerShell Gallery check that otherwise stops the command when a
newer Avm.Authoring version is available. Writes a warning once.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `Switch` |
| Required | false |
| Position | named |
| Default value | False |
| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

### -ThrottleLimit

Maximum number of independent Terraform scopes to process at once.
Defaults to four. Bicep lint currently ignores this value.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `Int32` |
| Required | false |
| Position | named |
| Default value | 4 |
| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

## Examples

### EXAMPLE 1

```powershell
avm lint
```

### EXAMPLE 2

```powershell
Invoke-AvmLint -Path C:\repos\my-module -Ecosystem bicep
```

## Outputs

- `pscustomobject from the engine: Engine, Tool, ToolPath, ToolSource,
Status, FilesProcessed, Issues.`
